## Usage

```text
provenance fmt [path...] [flags]
```

Write the Markdown entity files under each path (default: the whole repository) in canonical form: frontmatter keys in schema order, one field per line, lists in block style, empty fields left out, text with line breaks as literal blocks. The body is kept as written. Edits to different fields of a file in canonical form merge cleanly.

Only the files changed since HEAD (staged, unstaged or untracked) are formatted, so a file nobody touched never changes by accident; `--all` formats every entity file. Each file rewritten is printed. Nothing is written unless every value reads back the same and formatting again changes nothing.

`--check` writes nothing and lists each file not in canonical form. fmt `--all` `--check` is the merge gate's check; validate reports the same files as content/format warnings.

A file whose frontmatter does not parse, or whose type is not declared, is skipped and reported; validate reports why.

Exit codes: 0 done, or every file canonical with `--check`; 1 files not canonical with `--check`, or a file skipped; 2 tool or usage error.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` | — | format every entity file, not only those changed since HEAD |
| `--check` | — | list files not in canonical form instead of rewriting them |
